19K likes, 172 comments - fitmom.club on April 18, 2022: "This is What I did to lose 20 kgs :

✅I Limited added sugars. These are the sugars in cookies, cakes, sugar-sweetened drinks, and other items -- not the sugars that are naturally in fruits, for instance. Sugary foods often have a lot of calories but few nutrients. To calm my cravings I ate my favorite sweet once in a while.
✅ Got choosy about my carbs. You can decide which ones you eat, and how much. Look for those that are low on the glycemic index. Always prefer whole grains.
✅ Eat protein with every meal I made sure to have my protein with every meal. This way I was able to keep my metabolism high.
✅ Make friends with good fats. Small amounts of fat can help you feel full and less like you’re on a diet. The better choices are those in nuts.
✅ Don't forget to workout daily and to build lean muscle mass 💪

1,692 likes, 26 comments - fitmom.club on October 8, 2026: "🔔Save & share this reel with everyone🔔
Some common exposures to be more mindful of:

* 🚫 BPA/BPS- May disrupt hormones
* 🚫 PFAS- Persist in environment
* 🚫 Phthalates- Can affect hormones
* 🚫 Microplastics- Increase chemical exposure
* 🚫 Non-stick chemicals- Potential health concerns
* 🚫 Synthetic fragrances- May irritate airways
* 🚫 Pesticides- Leave chemical residues
* 🚫 Flame retardants- May affect hormones
* 🚫 VOCs- Pollute indoor air
* 🚫 Heavy metals- Can cause toxicity

You don’t need to fear every chemical or throw everything away. Start with simple swaps:

🥤 Plastic → Glass/stainless steel
🍳 Non-stick → Cast iron/stainless steel
🕯️ Paraffin candles → Beeswax/plant wax
🌸 Synthetic fragrance → Fragrance-free
🍱 Plastic storage → Glass
🔥 Never heat food in plastic
🌬️ Improve ventilation → Cleaner air
📱 Wireless devices → Create distance when practical
🧴 Complex products → Simpler ingredient

#holisticliving #nontoxiclifestyle #healthyswaps #wellness #healthylifestyle

(toxins, chemicals, hormones, plastics, fragrance, pesticides, ventilation, exposure, awareness, home, wellness)".

451 likes, 4 comments - fitmom.club on October 7, 2026: "✨Save & share this reel with everyone✨
You don’t need a bathroom full of hair products to care for your scalp. Try these 4 easy exercises to promote scalp massage and circulation.

 1. Head Tapping - 1 min - Gently tap across your scalp with your fingertips.
2. Gentle Hair Pulling - 2 min - Use very light tension at the roots, never pull hard.
3. Forward Combing - 2 min - Bend forward and gently comb through your hair from roots to ends.
4. Head Drop - 1 min - Let your head rest forward comfortably for a short period.

 Keep it gentle and consistent.

 #haircare #scalpcare #hairgrowth #healthyhair #selfcare

 (hairfall, circulation, massage, follicles, wellness, routine, beauty, grooming, hairhealth, relaxation, lifestyle, nourishment, selfcare, hairtips, scalpcare, healthyhair)".

One of the first acts of love for your baby starts with the choices you make on your plate. ❤️

Eggs are packed with important nutrients, but during pregnancy, raw or undercooked eggs can carry a risk of Salmonella. Choosing fully cooked eggs is a simple step towards safer, healthier eating.

Small, informed choices can make a big difference for both you and your baby. 🤰

Let’s make every meal a choice for health and safety. *LStay safe, eat well!

#pregnancysafety #healthypregnancy #maternalwellness #expectingmom #safefoodchoices
